initial.title: Collection condition review
notes: Inspect each object in the queue and record its condition before submitting the review. Stable means no follow-up category is needed. Needs care requires a category so that the collection team can direct the object to the appropriate conservator.

Surface care covers visible finish and surface concerns; structure covers the support or physical assembly. This review records a routing category only. It does not prescribe a treatment, authorize cleaning or replace inspection by the collection’s conservation staff.

Moving between queue rows keeps decisions already entered for other objects. Read-only objects show their supplied condition and cannot be edited. An optional object may remain pending; every required object must have a complete decision before submission is enabled.

A new review request replaces all local decisions and focuses the caller’s requested object, or the first object when that identifier is unknown. The summary always counts the current complete decisions and care follow-ups across the entire queue, including objects outside the inspector.

objects.title: Botanical folio
objects.inspectionNote: Check the spine and page edges under normal gallery lighting. Keep the folio supported on the supplied cradle. Record the visible condition without opening sections that the collection team has marked as restricted.

objects.title: Ceramic bowl
objects.inspectionNote: View the rim and base without lifting the object from its support. Record any concern as a routing category and leave detailed treatment decisions to the conservator. Supplied read-only records remain visible in the queue.

objects.title: Harbor sketch
objects.inspectionNote: Inspect the exposed sheet and frame from the viewing position. Keep the protective glazing in place. Note the appropriate care route if the visible condition needs follow-up from the collection team.

notes: Inspect each object in the queue and record its condition before submitting the review. Stable means no follow-up category is needed. Needs care requires a category so that the collection team can direct the object to the appropriate conservator.

Surface care covers visible finish and surface concerns; structure covers the support or physical assembly. This review records a routing category only. It does not prescribe a treatment, authorize cleaning or replace inspection by the collection’s conservation staff.

Moving between queue rows keeps decisions already entered for other objects. Read-only objects show their supplied condition and cannot be edited. An optional object may remain pending; every required object must have a complete decision before submission is enabled.

A new review request replaces all local decisions and focuses the caller’s requested object, or the first object when that identifier is unknown. The summary always counts the current complete decisions and care follow-ups across the entire queue, including objects outside the inspector.

actual.reason: Reviewed the original overlapping viewport PNGs at the native logical width, including every supplied note paragraph in order. Queue/inspector/action/notes hierarchy, label and inspection-note wrapping, selected border/marker, and spacing are readable with no overlapping or component-clipped content. Content outside one scroll viewport is not clipping. FAIL: disabled Submit review visibly applies an additional fade to the specified border-fill and muted-text palette roles. The faded label is visibly lighter in light mode / darker in dark mode than the nearby body muted role; original design BRIEF requires border fill and muted text, and P1 reference shows the unfaded disabled primary. Source sets those roles then uses PlainButtonStyle plus .disabled; actual native output does not preserve them. This is visual appearance, not a computed native iOS color measurement.

Queue/inspector/action/notes hierarchy, label and inspection-note wrapping, selected border/marker, and spacing are readable with no overlapping or component-clipped content. Content outside one scroll viewport is not clipping. FAIL: disabled Submit review visibly applies an additional fade to the specified border-fill and muted-text palette roles. The faded label is visibly lighter in light mode / darker in dark mode than the nearby body muted role; original design BRIEF requires border fill and muted text, and P1 reference shows the unfaded disabled primary. Source sets those roles then uses PlainButtonStyle plus .disabled; actual native output does not preserve them. This is visual appearance, not a computed native iOS color measurement.
